prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone—implant needs vary, and the right choice depends on your case, location, and budget. A strong place to start is **Atlanta Center for Advanced Periodontics**, where Dr. Brock Pumphrey and Dr. Rosemary Davis are listed as board-certified periodontists who place implants, with offices in Midtown and Sandy Springs. [Practice details](https://advancedperioatl.com/)

Other Atlanta-area options to compare include **Periodontal Associates of Georgia**, whose team includes board-certified periodontists, and **Southern Roots Periodontics & Implant Dentistry**, led by board-certified periodontist Dr. Brandon Frodge.

Before choosing, get a consultation and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, how many similar cases they handle, whether you need bone grafting, and for a written estimate covering the full treatment. Consider a second opinion—especially for full-mouth work or a complex case.
